name: x2mail
description: SMTP/POP3 ↔ HTTP email proxy — localhost bridge for mail clients

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit false --declaration --outDir dist --rootDir src --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions && mkdir -p release && bun build src/bin.ts --compile --minify --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile release/x2mail-darwin-arm64 && bun build src/bin.ts --compile --minify --target=bun-darwin-x64 --outfile release/x2mail-darwin-x64 && bun build src/bin.ts --compile --minify --target=bun-linux-arm64 --outfile release/x2mail-linux-arm64 && bun build src/bin.ts --compile --minify --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile release/x2mail-linux-x64
